# Phrase Ahem test font fixture

`PhraseAhem.ttf` is copied unchanged from the
[Text fixture](../../../../../surgeist-text/tests/fixtures/fonts/phrase-ahem/PROVENANCE.md).
That provenance describes the generator, the pinned [Ahem](../ahem/PROVENANCE.md)
input, the restricted character map and the independent phrase expectations. This
copy has no generator of its own; Layout tests include the bytes so that the crate
reads no file outside its own directory.

SHA-256: `89e2e33cb2874df25a62f41d483071c65c42ac8c2fa6ff7e5f75602a8a8091d8`.

The font is a derivative of the public domain Ahem, which carries a Creative
Commons Zero fallback. The same [declaration](../../../../licenses/ahem/COPYING) and
[upstream README](../../../../licenses/ahem/UPSTREAM-README) apply. No new font or
software was acquired.
